verdict.rationale: Independent reviews credit the chip as energy efficient with strong productivity performance. TechPowerUp notes the inverted cache stacking lets cores dissipate heat directly to the cooler, which supports sustained clocks. However, the pack has no documented power envelope (TDP/PPT) and no sustained-load or perf-per-watt render data. missing for 10: documented power envelope/TDP specs, independent sustained long-render throttling tests, quantified performance-per-watt measurements.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt

citations.quote: strong productivity performance; fully overclockable; energy efficient
CPU cores dissipate heat directly to the cooler without structural silicon in the way, giving thermal and overclocking characteristics like non-X3D models
The new $700 flagship offers the best application performance, beating even the 9950X
